items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 21 at 7:57PM EST until November 23 at 6:00AM EST by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...East winds 15 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and seas 7
to 10 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Ocracoke Inlet to Surf City.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM EST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
